reviews.title: It Was Good Until It Wasn't
reviews.text: It has one question that won't recognize the correct answer so it won't allow you to advance. I tried everything I could to get past that question and reset the app, but nothing worked.

reviews.title: Nothing But Ads
reviews.text: The game portion of this app is nothing but ads. For each question you answer wrong, you watch an ad. After every 3 questions you get right, you’re forced to watch an ad. This app teaches you nothing about the Bible nor does it give any incentive to try to learn. All it does is shows ad after ad after ad. This isn’t teaching about God or the Bible. It’s a sell out for $$$.

reviews.title: Too Many Ads on start up
reviews.text: To many add in the way .As soon as I open the app a ad pops up waited 3 minute once that’s done I’m trying to explore and see how the app works then another app pops up , I’m being forced to wait , watch until it’s done for another 3 mintues . I understand you have to make your money but don’t put the 2-3 ads in the beginning. I had to remove the app it’s awful .
